producer_report.summary: Added improvement_cycle in athena-data and an `improvement cycle:` line in athena status. The evaluated stage now needs a recorded evaluation on the proposal (new optional field on the existing proposal record), not the count of cited jobs. Proposals link to findings by introspection id or failure class. Empty records give not shown. Spec, CHANGELOG and tests updated; fmt, clippy and the full test suite pass. On real records the line will read not shown, since nothing writes evaluations yet.

checks_run.note: 12 passed, including the 8 new improvement-cycle and evaluation tests
background run finished with exit code 0

criteria_check.criterion: docs/spec.toml OLY-10-02 has a mechanism naming an existing crates/ path and function (not "none"), owner Athena kept, and a measure ending in `status: <label>` where the label is a line `athena status` prints, or `status: not shown` plus the test name. Check by Grep on docs/spec.toml and on the named function in crates/.
criteria_check.evidence: Read docs/spec.toml. Mechanism names introspection.rs improvement_cycle and status.rs improvement_cycle_line (both exist). Owner Athena. Measure names the test and ends in `status: not shown`.

criteria_check.criterion: In crates/athena-data/src/records/introspection.rs, fn improvement_cycle no longer contains a `jobs.len() >= 2`-style filter for the evaluated stage. A code comment names the record field used as the evaluation signal. Check with Grep for the removed filter and the comment.
criteria_check.evidence: No jobs.len() filter. Evaluated uses p.evaluation validated; comment says "The evaluation signal is `ProposalRecord::evaluation`".

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-data introspection`. Tests with fixtures shaped like real records show: a proposal with no evaluation record is not counted as evaluated; one with an evaluation record is; a finding about a different failure class or introspection than the proposal does not complete the chain; and a set missing any one stage reports that stage missing. The tests fail if the check always returns shown or always missing.
criteria_check.evidence: Ran it: 12 passed. Tests cover no-evaluation (Evaluated and Adoption missing), evaluated and decided (shown), other class (Candidate onward missing), link by cited introspection, and each single missing stage. Both shown and missing outcomes are asserted.

criteria_check.criterion: An empty record set reports not shown, never success (no-empty-success). A test in `cargo test -p athena-data introspection` covers it.

A test replays the check over a fixture mixing evaluated and unevaluated proposals, with the proposals built like real ones (3 distinct source jobs). It asserts both outcomes occur and that the stage is neither true for all nor false for all. Run `cargo test -p athena-data introspection`.
criteria_check.evidence: introspection_cycle_replay_over_mixed_proposals_finds_both_outcomes passed: results [true,false,false], any true and any false, 3 distinct source jobs each.

criteria_check.criterion: `athena status` prints the `improvement cycle:` line, and display tests assert it for both shown and `not shown (missing: ...)`, with the unevaluated case naming the evaluation stage. Run `cargo test -p athena-cli` and `cargo test -p athena-core status`. All existing tests that read status output still pass.
criteria_check.evidence: display.rs prints the line; status_prints_the_improvement_cycle_line_for_both_outcomes passed (real empty-records status, unevaluated case, shown case). The shown and unevaluated cases set the view field from improvement_cycle_line rather than seeding a real chain. athena-core status: 69 passed; full suite exit 0.

criteria_check.criterion: In crates/athena-core/src/status.rs the doc comment sits on the function it describes: build_measurement_line keeps its own rustdoc and improvement_cycle_line has its own. Check with git diff.
criteria_check.evidence: New functions were inserted with their own rustdoc after build_measurement_line; its rustdoc is untouched.

criteria_check.criterion: Any new record or data type is covered by the allow-list and round-trip test (check_record_file/AnyRecord in crates/athena-data/src/records.rs), or no new record type is added. Check by Grep and git diff.
criteria_check.evidence: No new record type; ProposalEvaluation is an optional field of the existing defaults-proposal record, covered by a records.rs test using check_record_file and AnyRecord::parse, plus a round-trip test in introspection.rs.

Run `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test`. All pass.
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks. I ran cargo fmt --all, clippy (clean) and the full cargo test --locked --no-fail-fast (exit 0).

open_issues: On real records the line reads not shown because nothing writes a proposal's evaluation field yet; no command records one (out of scope).
The repair stage is satisfied by any landed job named by an introspection or proposal source, not tied to the specific defect job.
mistakes: First helper name landed_jobs collided with an existing function; renamed to landed_job_ids.
learnings: No record held a baseline-versus-candidate result, so an optional evaluation field was added to the existing defaults-proposal record (skipped when absent).
Evaluation uses u32 failure counts because ProposalRecord derives Eq.
athena-core already has landed_jobs in status/throughput.rs; the new helper is landed_job_ids.
